name: rosetta-iterators
code:
use default

squares(count: int) -> Pipe[int] is
    for value in 1::count do
        yield value * value
    od
si

show(caption: string, values: Iterable[int]) is
    let shown = values |> map(value => "{value}") |> join(" ")

    write_line("{caption}: {shown}")
si

show("array", [3, 1, 2])
show("list", LIST([3, 1, 2]))
show("set", SET([3, 1, 2]))
show("range", 1::4)
show("generator", squares(4))
